description: This file defines data models related to budgets in a financial tracking application. It includes an enum for budget periods (weekly and monthly) with conversion methods for database interactions, and a 'BudgetModel' class representing budget entries with methods for serialization/deserialization, copying, and building specific instances.

classes.name: BudgetModel
classes.description: A data model representing a budget entry, including properties like id, categoryId, amount, period, startDate, and endDate, along with methods for creating instances from a map, converting to a map, copying with modifications, and constructing monthly budgets.

methods.name: fromDb
methods.description: Converts a database string value to the BudgetPeriod enum.

methods.name: get dbValue
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the BudgetPeriod for database storage.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Creates a BudgetModel instance from a map, typically from a database row.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the BudgetModel instance into a map suitable for database insertion or update.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a new BudgetModel instance with some properties replaced by provided values.

methods.name: monthly
methods.description: Builds a BudgetModel representing a monthly budget for a specified start and end date.
